home.eyebrow: Language learning starts with a smarter choice
home.description: Athenlio brings language courses and tutors into one clear experience, helping you compare options and choose around your goals, level and learning style.
home.trustCue: Two equally clear paths toward one goal: more effective language learning
home.coursePathText: Explore courses by language, level and learning structure.
home.tutorPathText: Review tutor profiles and find a teaching style that fits you.
home.pathsTitle: Learn in the way that works for you
home.pathsDescription: Start with a structured course or find a tutor for your exact goal. Neither path is secondary in Athenlio.
home.coursesDescription: Review language courses through clear, scannable information and make a better choice before requesting enrollment.
home.coursesFeatureOne: Filter by language and learning level
home.coursesFeatureTwo: Review the tutor and course structure
home.tutorsDescription: Explore professional tutor profiles and understand their experience, languages and teaching approach before choosing.
home.journeyTitle: Three steps to a better choice
home.journeyStep1Text: Explore courses and tutors based on your goal and current level.
home.journeyStep2Text: See the information that matters together and choose with confidence.
home.journeyStep3Text: Submit an enrollment request and follow its status from your dashboard.
home.ctaDescription: Create an account to manage your courses, selected tutors and enrollment requests in one place as the experience expands.

footer.description: A bilingual platform for discovering language courses and tutors, designed for clearer choices and a more human learning experience.
